title: Window
description: The window module displays the title of the currently focused window in niri.

placeholders.description: The current title of the focused window.
The current app ID of the focused window.
The current column of the focused window in the workspace.
The maximum column inside the workspace of the focused window.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how information should be displayed. On {} the current window title is displayed.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

rewrite.label: Rewrite
rewrite.doc: Rules to rewrite window title. See rewrite rules.
rewrite.description: Rules to rewrite window title. See rewrite rules.

separate-outputs.label: Separate outputs
separate-outputs.doc: Show the active window of the monitor the bar belongs to, instead of the focused window.
separate-outputs.description: Show the active window of the monitor the bar belongs to, instead of the focused window.

icon.label: Icon
icon.doc: Option to hide the application icon.
icon.description: Option to hide the application icon.

icon-size.label: Icon size
icon-size.doc: Option to change the size of the application icon.
icon-size.description: Option to change the size of the application icon.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.

show-empty.label: Show empty
show-empty.doc: When no window is focused (empty workspace or all windows closed), keep the module visible and render format with empty {title}/{app_id} and {col}/{max_col} set to -1. When false (the default), the module is hidden while no window is focused.
